Modification function to select columns in data, row_data or col_data

mod_select.Rd

Modification (mod) function to select columns in data, row_data or col_data. It is a wrapper function to dplyr::select() made for metime_analyser objects.

Usage

mod_select(object, which_data, type = "data", ...)

Arguments

object

A S4 object of class metime_analyser.

which_data

a vector of character defining which data/result is to be filtered.

type

character input of length 1 to define the type of data to be manipulated. Accepted inputs are "row_data", "col_data", "data" and "results". However renamed results will be returned to the user as a list of results and will not return the full analyser object

...

arguments to pass directly into dplyr::filter() function.

Value

object with mutated data, col_data or row_data. However, if type is "results" then plot_data with modifications expected will be returned

See also

mod_mutate, mod_rename, mod_filter
